name: Knee Osteoarthritis
definition: Degenerative whole-joint disorder characterized by cartilage loss, subchondral and osteophyte change, synovial involvement and pain/function impairment.

typical: Difficulty with stairs, walking or rising from chair

redFlags.item: Acute locked knee or major trauma

investigations.principle: Typical OA is often diagnosed clinically; image when diagnosis, severity or planning requires it.
investigations.MRI: MRI is not routine for typical knee OA.
investigations.radiographs: Weight-bearing radiographs assess joint-space loss, osteophytes and alignment.

green: Education, exercise and weight management when relevant
amber: Topical/oral medicines, injections and arthroplasty decisions depend on patient-specific risk and persistent disability.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Sandhigata Vata is a common clinical correlation; individualized assessment remains necessary.

patientEducation.summary: Degenerative whole-joint disorder characterized by cartilage loss, subchondral and osteophyte change, synovial involvement and pain/function impairment.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for new/progressive major weakness, gait deterioration, bladder/bowel dysfunction, saddle sensory loss, fever/systemic illness with severe spinal/joint pain, major trauma, or other listed red flags.
